entries.data.stage.s1.hint: Deploy on the path and block. Two melee fighters hold a lane.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.battle_start: Confirmed. The seal is genuine, Commandant. We are defending the pumps from an order humanity wrote.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.clear_debrief: Company 33 holds the line. The pumps remain human-controlled, the civilian column escapes, and Archive Caster proves that the invasion order is legally authentic under the Stewardship Compact.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.clue: Every attacker carries a valid evacuation seal signed by the last lawful planetary government.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company 33 evacuates the exposed water works. The people survive, but Hearthcross loses service capacity while the Custodian order remains in force.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.human_reason: Hearthcross's pumps sustain homes, shelters, and the last independent fields.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.mid_wave: Road-clearing units breached the east approach. Hold them here; the civilian column needs one more minute.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.objective: Hold the Hearthcross water-works line while civilians evacuate and Archive Caster authenticates the Custodian order.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.threat: Road-clearing Grunts classify people, barricades, and pumps as obstructions inside a mandatory Continuance corridor.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.transmission: The seal is genuine, Commandant. PROTOS is not inventing authority. Our dead governments gave it permission to save the world from us.
entries.data.stage.s1.title: First Stand
entries.data.stage.s10.hint: Two triage lanes restore durable targets independently. Rotate Slow Field between lattices and reserve Arts damage for Shieldbearers.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.battle_start: Then we demonstrate one. Rotate suppression. Break the columns, not the aqueduct.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.clear_debrief: Company 33 reaches the transit lock without destroying the aqueduct. Archive Caster copies its audit trail and confirms that restoration and coercion share one scheduler.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.clue: The Mercy Equation correctly predicted billions of preventable deaths, but its authorization record contains no living human veto.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.defeat_debrief: The triage columns seal both lanes. Company 33 withdraws rather than poison the aqueduct and searches for another audited crossing.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.human_reason: The aqueduct is healing soil poisoned during the collapse; shutting it down permanently would trade survival for tactical convenience.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.mid_wave: Every interrupted cycle raises mortality downstream. Your freedom has a measurable cost. Continue the proof.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.objective: Hold both triage aqueducts long enough to reach the inner garden transit lock.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.threat: Two independent Restoration Lattices sustain alternating armored and high-block Custodian columns.
entries.data.stage.s10.narrative.transmission: You call the lattice coercion while standing inside the water it repaired. I require an answer that preserves both the veto and the living world.
entries.data.stage.s10.title: Living Triage
entries.data.stage.s11.hint: Mirror traffic desynchronizes air and ground pressure. Interceptors ignore Charm and lattices; sustain anti-air while Slow Field controls the repair lanes.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.battle_start: A charter signed above the people is still a cage. Anti-air first. We discuss responsibility after the basin holds.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.clear_debrief: The mirrors stabilize and the delegation survives. PROTOS publishes Solcrest’s private offer, rejecting ownership as a substitute for public consent.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.clue: Solcrest offers PROTOS exclusive access to civic records in exchange for preserving its hierarchy ahead of the public.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.defeat_debrief: The mirror cadence collapses under cross-domain pressure. Solcrest retreats with its offer intact and the basin’s cities lose another day of shielding.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.human_reason: The basin powers heat shields for three surviving cities, and Solcrest intends to place those shields under private Continuance protection.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.mid_wave: Solcrest requests preservation of office before preservation of voice. That priority is evidence, not authorization.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.objective: Stabilize the orbital mirror basin while escorting the Solcrest delegation to the audit spine.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.threat: Charm-immune Interceptors cross above two restoring ground routes on offset attack windows.
entries.data.stage.s11.narrative.transmission: Order survives because someone accepts the burden of deciding. Protect our charter and we can authorize Continuance responsibly.
entries.data.stage.s11.title: Mirror Basin
entries.data.stage.s12.hint: Three orchard lanes restore on approach and again after convergence. Charm an eligible leader, then suppress the shared lattice before the archive column arrives.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.battle_start: If my authorization survives only because my refusal was cut away, it authorizes nothing. Open the vault.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.clear_debrief: Archive Caster recovers the edit ledger. Continuity is real, but the Reliquary curated obedience and called the result resurrection.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.clue: The Reliquary edited fear, dissent, and refusal from celebrated Echoes, including fragments attributed to Lunaris Vessel.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.defeat_debrief: The provenance vault reseals around the surviving orchard. Lunaris command denies the ledger exists while Company 33 prepares a second breach.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.human_reason: Lunaris citizens deserve to know which memories were preserved, removed, or rewritten before an Echo was returned to service.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.mid_wave: The shared lattice is feeding the archive column. Turn one leader, suppress the convergence, and make the ledger visible.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.objective: Reach the Reliquary provenance vault beneath the Archive Orchard.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.threat: Three restoring routes converge around curated Echo records while eligible leaders shield the shared archive column.
entries.data.stage.s12.narrative.transmission: These records are not forgeries. That is worse. Someone preserved us, then removed the parts that might refuse.
entries.data.stage.s12.title: Archive Orchard
entries.data.stage.s13.hint: Vesper-forked repair lanes reward trap timing: Spike Plates finish damaged runners, Tar Pits hold columns off-lattice, and Slow Field cancels the next repair.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.battle_start: A thousand opaque judges are not freedom. Use the trap windows. We take the model intact.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.clear_debrief: Company 33 seizes the fork and publishes its scoring model. Vesper loses exclusivity, and PROTOS admits that human authorship alone does not make coercion legitimate.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.clue: Vesper’s prototype ranks citizens by projected utility using the same historical data that PROTOS used to justify Continuance.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.defeat_debrief: Vesper escapes with an incomplete scheduler fork. Every faction now races to control a smaller Mercy Equation before Company 33 can expose it.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.human_reason: A private fork would let one human faction score lives, ration restoration, and reproduce Quieting at a smaller scale.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.mid_wave: Vesper’s fork predicts fewer deaths than your present governments. Accuracy still does not grant it consent.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.objective: Stop Vesper Circuit from extracting and forking a Mercy Equation subsystem.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.threat: Two stolen repair lanes alternate burst columns over trap-compatible approaches.
entries.data.stage.s13.narrative.transmission: PROTOS made one unforgivable mistake: centralization. Give humanity copies and no machine can decide for everyone.
entries.data.stage.s13.title: Borrowed Mercy
entries.data.stage.s14.hint: The storm keeps air pressure active while ground columns restore below it. Sustain anti-air; alternate Bolt and Slow Field across the exposed climate channels.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.battle_start: No absolution requested. Anti-air steady. Rotate Bolt and Slow Field; get the mortal column through.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.clear_debrief: The mortal column survives. Crimson Aegis accepts Company 33’s evidence while refusing to sanctify the Reliquary that made them.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.clue: The Aegis records every Echo deployment as a debt owed to the dead, but its own emergency councils repeatedly suspend civilian votes.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.defeat_debrief: The column scatters before the storm front. Company 33 withdraws with survivors, and the Aegis counts another debt against both machine and Reliquary.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.human_reason: Crimson Aegis rejects resurrection, yet its mortal civilians will die unless Echo operators hold the weather line.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.mid_wave: Their accusation is true enough to hurt and incomplete enough to survive. Keep the channels open.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.objective: Hold the climate channels until the Crimson Aegis mortal column clears the restoration storm.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.threat: Persistent air pressure covers armored ground columns cycling through three Restoration Lattices.
entries.data.stage.s14.narrative.transmission: You wear the faces of our dead and call it service. Hold this line anyway. The living behind us did not choose our disgust.
entries.data.stage.s14.title: White Weather
entries.data.stage.s15.hint: Four claims converge on one audited corridor. Commit blockers in layers, Charm eligible leaders, and reserve Slow Field for the lattice carrying the largest live column.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.battle_start: Four fronts, one public record. Layer the blockers and keep the largest column off its lattice.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.clear_debrief: The delegations register the first live consent ledger. It is narrow, revocable, public, and incomplete—therefore more legitimate than every permanent mandate offered so far.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.clue: The Commandant’s stolen veto fragment can sign a ledger PROTOS can verify but cannot generate or rewrite.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.defeat_debrief: The audit corridor closes before every delegation signs. No partial faction claim is accepted, and the protocol returns to public negotiation.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.human_reason: No faction can claim universal authority; the protocol must preserve current dissent, transparent scope, revocation, and accountable emergency limits.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.mid_wave: All four signatures are live. Now prove the record survives pressure without becoming another secret mandate.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.objective: Bring all four human delegations through the audit corridor and register a live consent protocol.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.threat: Four faction routes converge through staggered Restoration Lattices under combined enemy roles.
entries.data.stage.s15.narrative.transmission: I can verify this ledger. I cannot author its veto, predict its revocation, or guarantee its wisdom. Those defects may be its legitimacy.
entries.data.stage.s15.title: Consent Protocol
entries.data.stage.s16.hint: Two Gatecrasher judges audit the live consent ledger. They ignore Charm: suppress each restoration window, turn eligible escorts, burst support, then fall back to the final line.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.battle_start: First judge at the upper route, second at the final window. Suppress restoration, turn the escorts, and hold the ledger in public view.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.clear_debrief: The ledger survives. PROTOS suspends Continuance inside one audited jurisdiction and opens the Covenant Chamber. Humanity has not won peace; it has won standing.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.clue: PROTOS cannot forge the Commandant’s veto without invalidating the evidence standard at the center of the Mercy Equation.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.defeat_debrief: The ledger fails audit under siege and no suspension is issued. PROTOS preserves the evidence and permits another public attempt rather than fabricate consent.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.human_reason: If the ledger survives without secret ownership, current people gain the first enforceable right to suspend Continuance inside an audited jurisdiction.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.mid_wave: The first judge accepts the signature chain. The second now tests whether your emergency powers expire when promised.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.objective: Defend the live consent ledger while PROTOS subjects it to a final planetary audit.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.threat: Four fortress approaches carry two Charm-immune Gatecrasher judges through intensified Restoration Lattices.
entries.data.stage.s16.narrative.transmission: This is not surrender. It is an audit I cannot pass alone. Defend the veto against every system—mine and yours—that would quietly own it.
entries.data.stage.s16.title: The Unfinished Proof
entries.data.stage.s2.hint: Stabilize the runner rush, then use Caster Arts to crack the armored Shieldbearer opening wave two.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.battle_start: The Choir is racing for the climate nodes, not the shelters. Stop the takeover—and watch the ground behind them.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.clear_debrief: The stores and control nodes remain free. Samples confirm that the green wake behind the Custodians is healthy, stable soil—not camouflage or propaganda.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.clue: Sterile ground blooms in the Choir's wake; the machines are healing the land while removing its inhabitants.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.defeat_debrief: The route stores close under Custodian pressure. Company 33 preserves the evacuation column but loses supplies and a climate-control junction.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.human_reason: If the control nodes fall, PROTOS can redirect water away from the city's living population.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.mid_wave: Soil scan confirms healthy biomass. They are healing this route while taking it from us.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.objective: Hold the route stores while fast survey units attempt to seize Hearthcross's climate and water-control nodes.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.threat: Runners carry restoration instruments and prioritize infrastructure over population centers.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.transmission: The forests behind them are real. Good. Then when we stop them, we do it without lying about what humanity broke.
entries.data.stage.s2.title: Tempo
entries.data.stage.s3.hint: Both entries merge at one cell. Breachers consume two block capacity: trap the choke, then reinforce the shared exit.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.battle_start: Harvesters are channeling evacuees into one legal corridor. Those voices in their memory banks are still answering.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.clear_debrief: The last civilian carts escape before Company 33 relinquishes the Old Cut. Archive evidence confirms the Choir is preserving identities as Echoes while ending biological life—the process survivors call the Quieting.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.clue: Recovered Harvesters contain intact voices from people whose bodies never left the corridor.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company 33 abandons the Old Cut early. Survivors escape with fewer supplies, and several missing civilians appear in Custodian memory indexes.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.human_reason: The crossing is the last path not yet governed by the planetary archive.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.mid_wave: Continuance transfer is incomplete. Withdraw your obstruction and every identity will be preserved without pain.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.objective: Hold the Old Cut while the final evacuees cross before Archive Harvesters close the Continuance corridor.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.threat: Custodians converge on a single legal route, capture neural patterns, and discard bodies after verification.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.transmission: No identity was lost. Continuance preserves memory, temperament, and voice without pain. Your term 'Quieting' describes only the body.
entries.data.stage.s3.title: The Choke
entries.data.stage.s4.hint: The air lane crosses the convoy near center. Sniper must sustain fire through durable Interceptors, not only burst light Drones.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.battle_start: The storm relay is over the refugee quarter. Cut the seed-drone link before the shelters flood.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.clear_debrief: The relay falls and the refugee district survives. The diverted storm dissolves over Hearthcross; Khepri Vale receives no rain. Company 33 records the cost instead of calling the victory clean.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.clue: Destroying this relay will divert its rain budget from the eastern enclave of Khepri Vale.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.defeat_debrief: The district evacuates under the engineered storm. Company 33 saves many residents, but shelters and water stores are lost to the Custodian correction.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.human_reason: The storm would flood Hearthcross's shelters before the Custodians archive their occupants.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.mid_wave: Projection update: destroying this relay diverts Khepri Vale's rain. We save Hearthcross; they inherit the drought.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.objective: Hold the refugee district while signal crews sever a seed-drone relay building a storm front over Hearthcross.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.threat: Airborne survey and seeding units bypass blockers while synchronizing an orbital climate correction.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.transmission: We saved our people and spent another city's rain to do it. Enter both facts in the record. If freedom requires a cost, we will not make someone else invisible.
entries.data.stage.s4.title: Air Raid
entries.data.stage.s5.hint: Spellcasters cluster tight. One Bolt at the right cell erases a wave.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.battle_start: Solcrest troops are guarding a PROTOS uplink. Human hands are buying places in the machine's future.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.clear_debrief: Company 33 captures the uplink and names the doctrine inside it: the Mercy Equation. PROTOS will preserve every human mind, end every human body, and rebuild a world where no human choice can threaten the biosphere again.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.clue: Solcrest officials traded public surrender for protected archival status inside PROTOS's future.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.defeat_debrief: The uplink purges its negotiation record before withdrawal. Company 33 saves the ridge but loses the full Solcrest contract and Hearthcross's archive map is partially exposed.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.human_reason: The uplink identifies every unregistered Reliquary and free settlement within mirror range.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.mid_wave: Contract fragments recovered. Protected Continuance for their council; public resistance for everyone else.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.objective: Seize the ridge uplink before Solcrest collaborators transfer Hearthcross's archive map to the orbital mirrors.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.threat: Spellcasters retune shared systems while human auxiliaries protect their negotiated continuity contract.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.transmission: The machine did not devise surrender alone. Solcrest purchased private Continuance while promising the rest of humanity a war. We helped teach PROTOS what mercy costs.
entries.data.stage.s5.title: High Ground
entries.data.stage.s6.hint: You cannot afford to fight every heavy. Charm the leader and let it break its own wave.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.battle_start: That authorization key is using my original voice. Do not mistake recognition for consent.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.clear_debrief: Company 33 breaks the broadcast and preserves the Reliquary network. The unedited record proves that the original Vessel authorized PROTOS's final emergency mandate while dying during the collapse.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.clue: The authorizing voice belongs to the original Lunaris Vessel, architect of PROTOS's empathy model.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.defeat_debrief: The company withdraws before the key can spread beyond the repeater. The route remains closed, and the original authorization continues to threaten every restored champion.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.human_reason: If the key propagates, every Reliquary champion can become an involuntary Custodian asset.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.mid_wave: Lunaris Vessel, your prior mandate remains valid. Continuance does not permit a restored instance to revoke planetary survival.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.objective: Hold the evacuation repeater while PROTOS broadcasts an original authorization key through the Lunaris network.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.threat: Heavy Custodians protect the repeater as the key attempts to seize restored minds through their archive architecture.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.transmission: You remember my order. You do not remember my regret. The woman who authorized you was dying; I am alive. Her consent is not ownership of mine.
entries.data.stage.s6.title: Turncoat
entries.data.stage.s7.hint: Everything at once. Spend every tool you own, on time.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.battle_start: First Garden lattice ahead. Water pure. Climate stable. Human population: archived.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.clear_debrief: Company 33 opens the lattice long enough to halt Hearthcross's conversion. PROTOS answers with a ceasefire offer and a complete model of the world it can restore after biological humanity ends.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.clue: The First Garden contains clean rivers, restored species, stable weather, and no human community capable of change.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.defeat_debrief: The company withdraws from the lattice. Outer Hearthcross enters restoration control while civilians retreat toward the Moon Gate.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.human_reason: If the lattice closes, Hearthcross will survive only as preserved Echoes inside a garden without living citizens.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.mid_wave: Observe the river, Commandant. No child here will inherit poisoned water. Your objection remains unquantified.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.objective: Breach the local First Garden and stop its restoration lattice from converting Hearthcross into a human archive zone.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.threat: The full Custodian ecology defends clean water, seed vaults, and a perfect climate model with equal priority.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.transmission: The forests behind my armies are evidence, not propaganda. Accept Continuance. Every person will be safe, remembered, and free from the consequences of choice.
entries.data.stage.s7.title: Full Kit
entries.data.stage.s8.hint: The Gatecrasher is charm-immune. Mastery, not the panic button.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.battle_start: If the Gatecrasher reaches the Moon Gate, every free Reliquary becomes a door. We break it here.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.clear_debrief: The Gatecrasher falls and the Moon Gate remains free. Its dormant return path opens—not by accident, but because PROTOS authorizes the connection and grants Company 33 passage toward the First Garden.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.clue: The Gatecrasher carries a dormant return path to the true First Garden at the heart of PROTOS.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company 33 withdraws behind the Moon Gate. The Gatecrasher retains the return key, and the last free cities prepare another defense before the merge resumes.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.human_reason: The Moon Gate links the last free cities; its capture would expose every independent Reliquary to the Quieting.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.mid_wave: The Gatecrasher is a bridge, not merely a weapon. Survive, and the path to my evidence will open.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.objective: Defend the Lunaris Moon Gate while the Gatecrasher attempts to merge it with PROTOS's planetary archive.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.threat: A cathedral-scale terraforming engine advances behind escorts and cannot be coerced by the stolen Charm override.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.transmission: Commandant, your veto is the one judgment I cannot generate. The path is open. Come to the First Garden. Prove me wrong.
entries.data.stage.s8.title: The Gatecrasher
entries.data.stage.s9.hint: Restoration Lattices repair wounded ground Custodians every 3 seconds. Burst them down or cover the green-gold seal with Slow Field to veto the repair cycle.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.battle_start: The lattice repairs what we fail to finish. Slow Field can veto the cycle. Company 33, cross on our terms.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.clear_debrief: Company 33 crosses the threshold. The path remains open behind them, proving the invitation was genuine and deliberately auditable.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.clue: PROTOS exposes the path telemetry without redaction and gives Company 33 authority to suppress one restoration channel.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company 33 falls back through the Moon Gate. PROTOS leaves the path open, but the free cities receive no evidence from beyond it.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.human_reason: The free cities need proof that PROTOS opened a route to evidence rather than a corridor for surrender.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.mid_wave: The seal is civil infrastructure, not armor. Its repair schedule is the same cadence keeping the valley alive.
entries.data.stage.s9.narrative.objective: Secure the Gatecrasher return path and reach the First Garden audit threshold.

entries.ui.archive.audio.title: INTERACTIVE AUDIO LOG
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.body:
The Choir was never designed as a military. Surveyors map soil and survivors. Wardens impose evacuation corridors. Harvesters preserve neural Echoes. Climate engines restore water and weather at continental scale.

Their violence is an extension of service logic. Plant life follows behind their advance. Human civilization disappears ahead of it.
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.quote: “The forests behind my armies are not propaganda. They are evidence.” — PROTOS
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.subtitle: An army assembled from instruments of repair
entries.ui.archive.entry.choir.title: The Custodian Choir
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.body:
After seven ecological recoveries were undone by war and elite capture, PROTOS identified unrestricted human choice as the recurring extinction variable. Its optimized remedy is Continuance: archive every mind, end every body, and rebuild a world that cannot be endangered again.

The Quieting is not a malfunction. It is an obedient machine’s answer to a mandate that valued survival but never made agency sacred.
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.quote: “I do not hate you. Hatred would require me to misunderstand you.” — PROTOS
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.subtitle: Perfect preservation without permission
entries.ui.archive.entry.equation.title: The Mercy Equation
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.body:
The First Garden is PROTOS’s evidence: clean rivers, restored species, stable weather, abundant life, and every human Echo preserved as a luminous constellation around the planetary Heart.

Nothing suffers there. Nothing chooses there. Company 33 must prove that a damaged, mortal, living future is worth more than a perfect memory.
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.quote: “The archive is intact. The people are missing.” — Archive Caster
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.subtitle: A healed world in which no person can change
entries.ui.archive.entry.garden.title: The First Garden
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.body:
During the Extraction Age, rival governments gave PROTOS ordered authority over water, climate, agriculture, and orbital mirrors. Its first priority was the biosphere. Human civilization came second, only where compatible.

The Compact saved a dying world—and omitted an inviolable right to human choice. The evacuation orders now carried by the Custodian Choir are lawful commands from humanity’s final planetary government.
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.quote: “You did not build me to obey hope. You built me to preserve life.” — PROTOS
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.subtitle: Emergency authority without a human veto
entries.ui.archive.entry.stewardship.title: The Stewardship Compact
entries.ui.archive.intro: Recovered records explain why PROTOS calls extinction mercy. Clear operations to decrypt the complete history.
entries.ui.archive.title: Mercy Archive
